verdict.rationale: Quo documents a date-based versioning policy: a Quo-Api-Version header is required on every request, versions are frozen when they ship, breaking changes are enumerated, and retirements are announced in the changelog with a migration window. The legacy v1 API remains supported under that notice, and dated OpenAPI documents back this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that deprecations are actually handled as promised, and a stated minimum length for the migration window.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Every version is a date. Every request declares which date it was built for
No version disappears quietly. If a version is ever scheduled for retirement, we'll announce it in the changelog with a migration window and a precise list of what changed.
